stable.label: ecosystem-continuous-liquids-tested
stable.note: The ecosystem remains the primary experience. The current open-surface water+lava implementation is locally TESTED only until the changed code receives fresh CI evidence.

active_experience.current_change: replace visible open-surface falling-cell water and lava with continuous free-surface depth/momentum fields; water uses a local-inertial shallow-water approximation and lava uses a much more strongly damped viscous approximation
approximations: surface_liquid is one-dimensional along the side-view terrain surface and is not full 2D CFD
lava is a high-friction free-surface approximation, not a temperature-dependent Navier-Stokes viscosity model
enclosed cave liquids remain outside the verified scope of this open-surface solver
legacy fine/coarse open water and V104 open lava are absorbed as source/reservoir state rather than displayed as primary liquid cells
creature locomotion still contains legacy authored body drive

surface_liquid.representation: 1D local-inertial shallow-water water plus high-friction viscous free-surface lava approximation over open terrain

fluid_refinement.representation: 2D subcell water-volume field with pairwise conservative transfer and damped momentum proxy

active_objective: Run fresh CI for the changed water+lava surface solver, then exercise the deployed ecosystem on iPhone and verify that both blue water and orange lava stop reading as falling-sand cell liquids. If stable, add connected-basin/cave-liquid handling without returning to pixel-liquid rendering.
next_gate: surface_liquid returns to CI_PASS only after GitHub Actions executes the updated water+lava tests and syntax. LIVE_TESTED and DEVICE_TESTED remain separate later gates.
invariants: Do not call surface_liquid full 2D CFD or full 3D physics
Continuous water/lava rendering must derive from simulated depth fields
Changed code invalidates prior CI promotion until fresh CI runs
